description: This file contains a unit test for the Router class from the litellm module. It verifies the correctness of the shallow copy optimization used in the default deployment mechanism, ensuring modifications to copied deployments do not affect the original or other copies.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class managing routing and deployment configurations, specifically handling default deployment shallow copy optimization in this test context.

methods.description: A test function that verifies the behavior of shallow copying deployments, ensuring modifications are properly isolated according to the intended design.
